predecessor.recoveryMeaning: Version 1 remains the last deployed recovery baseline until a separately verified Version 2 production receipt exists.

principles: Advance the existing authoritative system instead of copying it into a competing implementation.
Every source change declares extend, replace, migrate, retire, or guard before editing begins.
A replacement must name its predecessor, preserve required behavior, and prove rollback before the old path can retire.
Source, build, deployment, provider observation, audience movement, and commercial outcome remain separate states.
No build, synthetic action, system worker, or deployment manufactures audience, ranking, revenue, review, rating, or backlink evidence.
A successful product can be serious without losing DigitalHut's human voice, free-first access, or observatory character.

checkpointQuestions: Which authoritative system owns this behavior?
Does a working implementation already exist?
Are we extending it or accidentally rebuilding it?
What exact user-visible or operational delta should appear?
Which focused verifier will fail if the delta is absent?
Can the prior behavior be restored without deleting evidence?

operatorChallenge.rule: Codex must plainly challenge Anthony when a requested connection, metric, provider capability, release state, or business claim conflicts with inspected system truth.

releaseRule: States advance in order and remain individually receipted; no later label is inferred from an earlier state.

authority.sharedHandlerRule: Shared files are capability-scoped by method or explicit scope; filename overlap never implies shared authority.

socialServerBoundary.mixpost: separate PHP Laravel application with its own database, Redis queue, scheduler, credentials, and server lifecycle
socialServerBoundary.supabase: may store reviewed DigitalHut social evidence only after an explicit adapter and schema are verified
socialServerBoundary.googleCloudBuild: may verify and release DigitalHut adapter source but does not operate Mixpost posting by implication
socialServerBoundary.digitalhutFrontend: owns the pressured drawer, announcement preview, canonical destination, and deliberate operator action

version2Milestones.definition: Version contract, authority map, confusion guard, and recovery truth are executable.
Pressured social drawer and Social Observatory compile behind deliberate human posting.
Private Mixpost scheduler is connected through reviewed credentials and account-specific approvals.
Full insight map returns within a reviewed operational latency budget without removing durable truth.
Source, database, object, and deployment restoration are independently rehearsed.
One cumulative build, deployment, alias, postdeploy, and rollback receipt proves Version 2 live.
